case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

thank you for your offer and for the reliable cooperation. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. We ordered from you at EUR 339.37 per unit in 2024-09 and at EUR 348.32 per unit in 2026-09 (po:4500011414-10, po:4500014474-10). With the index clause the price follows copper beyond the deadband, so the copper risk no longer has to be priced in up front. On that basis we propose EUR 361.35 per unit, payment 90 days net, an index clause on CU-NOTATION (20 % material share, deadband 5 %, base month 2026-08).

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your proposal and agree that an index clause for copper aligns with our mutual interest in risk mitigation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We can accept your terms and await your order. Our Angebot is a price of €361.35 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. We are prepared to accept the 90 days net payment terms under these conditions. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
